Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Helios is ready to move from discovery to an architecture review so we can lock residency, networking, and deployment patterns for our pilot. High level asks:

- EU customers must keep all PHI-derived vectors and embeddings inside EU clusters (GDPR + local contracts).
- APAC pilot (Singapore) should prefer managed cloud in-region; if needed, we may consider a private on-prem box for one hospital group.
- US traffic can use Redwood-hosted with a dedicated capacity pool, but we need latency profiles for 1–8k concurrent inference connections.

Can your team run a 60–90m technical session next week to review: routing policies, model variant fallbacks, kv/prefix caching across regions, and examples of network egress/KMS integration?

Proposed windows (Helios execs + infra):
- Tue 2027-02-16 14:00–15:30 CET (08:00–09:30 EST)
- Wed 2027-02-17 02:00–03:30 SGT (Mon evening PST) — awkward but possible for APAC stakeholders
- Thu 2027-02-18 09:00–10:30 PST (17:00–18:30 CET)

I'll attach a short slide with the business constraints. Let me know who from Redwood should join and any pre-reads you want.

Thanks,
Sophie Lambert
Head of Platform Integrations – Helios Health
